milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate near the lodestone at spawn-relative position (6, 1, 6) and face toward it, confirming they have visually located it. max_distance=5 ensures meaningful navigation from spawn (~8.5 blocks diagonal away), and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the lodestone rather than just passing through the area.
